subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge, or should browser Canvas action ingress land first as the canonical web A2UI contract?
rationale: The request spans product direction and security boundaries: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Design after dashboard substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a security-reviewed bridge spec once the dashboard custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path.

options.title: Make Canvas ingress canonical first
options.body: Prioritize the browser Canvas action-ingress issues, then adapt dashboard widgets to that approved browser A2UI contract.

options.title: Move bridge outside core
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not core direction, route the idea to an external plugin or ClawHub package after the necessary APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Design after dashboard substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a security-reviewed bridge spec once the dashboard custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest visible history signal for both current Canvas A2UI action handling and the bundled plugin-tab precedent this feature would extend.
